knowledge:
- key_parameters: cut_pos=Zero-based numeric integer indicating the position at which the restriction enzyme cuts (e.g., 0 for DpnII, 1 for Csp6I or HindIII) ;; res_enz=The sequence recognized by the restriction enzyme used in the experiment (e.g., "GATC" for DpnII) ;; bait_seq=The downstream primer sequence (DS primer) matching the sequence of the queried viewpoint ;; bait_pad=The padding sequence corresponding to the nucleotides between the DS primer end and the next restriction enzyme site ;; grouping=Variable in colData (typically "condition") used to group samples for plotting or differential testing ;; bait_exclusion=Genomic region around the bait to exclude from analysis (default 3 kb) to avoid proximity bias ;; bait_expansion=Genomic window size centered on the viewpoint to focus the analysis (default 2Mb) ;; numb_reads=Parameter in contactsUMI4C to limit the number of reads loaded into memory at once to prevent memory issues
- alternatives: waldUMI4C() (DESeq2 Wald Test) is preferred when several replicates with high UMI depth are available ;; fisherUMI4C() (Fisher's Exact Test) is preferred when replicates are insufficient, UMI depth is low, or when focusing on a specific set of candidate regions (like enhancers)
- when_to_use: Use when characterizing 3D chromatin interactions with a specific bait/viewpoint of interest, especially when comparing changes in chromatin interactions between two conditions, cell types, or developmental stages with replicates
- pitfalls: Each analysis and UMI4C object must correspond to the same viewpoint; different viewpoints must be analyzed separately ;; The package can only handle a condition with exactly 2 levels for differential analysis; if there are more than two conditions, pairwise comparisons must be performed using separate UMI4C objects ;; Ensure that the Bowtie2 index, reference genome, and digested genome all correspond to the exact same assembly build (e.g., hg19) ;; Memory issues can occur during FASTQ processing; use numb_reads to limit memory usage

workflows.name: umi4c_analysis_workflow
workflows.intent: Process raw paired-end UMI-4C FASTQ files, align them to a digested reference genome, call significant interactions, perform differential testing between two conditions, and visualize the contact profiles.
input: R1/R2 FASTQ files (paired-end sequencing reads containing bait and UMI sequences)
BSgenome object (reference genome for in silico digestion)
Bowtie2 index files (reference genome index for alignment)
Metadata table / colData (sample sheet mapping sample IDs, replicates, conditions, and count file paths)
workflows.stages: 1. Demultiplex multiplexed FASTQ files using demultiplexFastq (optional) ;; 2. Perform in silico digestion of the reference genome using digestGenome ;; 3. Process raw FASTQ files to align reads and count UMIs using contactsUMI4C ;; 4. Generate alignment and filtering statistics using statsUMI4C ;; 5. Load count files and construct a UMI4C object using makeUMI4C ;; 6. Define candidate window fragments using makeWindowFragments ;; 7. Call significant interactions with the viewpoint using callInteractions and retrieve them with getSignInteractions ;; 8. Perform differential interaction analysis using waldUMI4C (DESeq2) or fisherUMI4C (Fisher's Exact Test) ;; 9. Retrieve differential results using resultsUMI4C ;; 10. Visualize contact profiles, domainograms, and differential results using plotUMI4C or plotInteractionsUMI4C
workflows.code:
## Demultiplex baits inside FastQ file (Optional)
demultiplexFastq(
    fastq = fastq,
    barcodes = barcodes,
    out_path = out_path
)

## Generate Digested genome
hg19_dpnii <- digestGenome(
    res_enz = "GATC",
    cut_pos = 0,
    name_RE = "dpnII",
    ref_gen = refgen,
    sel_chr = "chr16",
    out_path = file.path(tempdir(), "digested_genome/")
)

## Run main function to process UMI-4C contacts
contactsUMI4C(
    fastq_dir = raw_dir,
    wk_dir = file.path(path, "CIITA"),
    file_pattern = "ctrl_hi24_CIITA",
    bait_seq = "GGACAAGCTCCCTGCAACTCA",
    bait_pad = "GGACTTGCA",
    res_enz = "GATC",
    cut_pos = 0,
    digested_genome = hg19_dpnii,
    bowtie_index = index_path,
    ref_gen = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19,
    sel_seqname = "chr16",
    threads = 2,
    numb_reads = 1e6
)

## Get filtering and alignment stats
statsUMI4C(wk_dir = system.file("extdata", "CIITA",
    package = "UMI4Cats"
))

## Load sample processed file paths
files <- list.files(system.file("extdata", "CIITA", "count", package="UMI4Cats"),
                    pattern = "*_counts.tsv.gz",
                    full.names = TRUE
)

## Create colData including all relevant information
colData <- data.frame(
    sampleID = gsub("_counts.tsv.gz", "", basename(files)),
    file = files,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

library(tidyr)
colData <- colData |>
    separate(sampleID,
        into = c("condition", "replicate", "viewpoint"),
        remove = FALSE
    )

## Load UMI-4C data and generate UMI4C object
umi <- makeUMI4C(
    colData = colData,
    viewpoint_name = "CIITA",
    grouping = "condition",
    ref_umi4c = c("condition"="ctrl"),
    bait_expansion = 2e6
)

## Generate windows
win_frags <- makeWindowFragments(umi, n_frags=8)

## Call interactions
gr <-  callInteractions(umi4c = umi, 
                        design = ~condition, 
                        query_regions = win_frags, 
                        padj_threshold = 0.01, 
                        zscore_threshold=2)

## Plot interactions
all <- plotInteractionsUMI4C(umi, gr, grouping = NULL, significant=FALSE, xlim=c(10.75e6, 11.1e6))
sign <- plotInteractionsUMI4C(umi, gr, grouping = NULL, significant=TRUE, xlim=c(10.75e6, 11.1e6))
cowplot::plot_grid(all, sign, ncol=2, labels=c("All", "Significant"))

## Obtain unique significant interactions
inter <- getSignInteractions(gr)

## DESeq2 Wald Test
umi_wald <- waldUMI4C(umi,
                      query_regions = inter,
                      design = ~condition)

## Fisher's Exact Test
umi_fisher <- fisherUMI4C(umi,
                          grouping = "condition",
                          query_regions = inter,
                          filter_low = 20)

## Retrieve differential analysis results
resultsUMI4C(umi_fisher, ordered = TRUE, counts = TRUE, format = "data.frame")

## Plot replicates without grouping
plotUMI4C(umi,
    grouping = NULL,
    TxDb = TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene::TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene,
    OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db",
    dgram_plot = FALSE
)

## Plot differential results with grouping
plotUMI4C(umi_fisher, grouping = "condition", xlim=c(10.75e6, 11.25e6), ylim=c(0,10))
